name: core
label: Beatham
thesis: Serve, spark, delight. Personal tools, made at a workshop bench, that help you bring your ideas to life.
summary: Beatham is the brand of Jeremiah Beatham, a multidisciplinary designer who designs things and experiences, likes helping people, and likes making the work fun. The core is the lowest common denominator: what every Beatham app, site, watch face and printed part inherits. It sets the rules (color budget, accent rule, contrast, type jobs, spacing, shape, motion) and the raw material (the ramps, the filament palette, four OFL faces). Each product layers a brand on top: its own palettes, roles and voice, inside the same rules.

pillars.name: Servant
pillars.body: Help first. Build tools that care for people, their ideas and each other. Simple, straightforward, transparent.

pillars.name: Innovator
pillars.body: Ask why not. Make tools you can touch, and make them well, so ideas become things.

pillars.name: Entertainer
pillars.body: Find joy in the simplest things. How much play a product gets depends on the product.

type: SF Pro for all text (SF Compact on watchOS). Instrument Sans for titles only — it has no ± or µ, so titles never carry values.
JetBrains Mono for every number and value (dotted zero, tabular). Bitcount Single for one hero numeral per screen at most.
Apple Dynamic Type steps; bundled faces scale with Font.custom(_:size:relativeTo:) and fall back to SF.
do: Build every surface from the neutral ladder: true black → neutral/90 → neutral/80 in dark, paper → white in light.
Use the accent for the one thing being acted on: the selected segment, the active control, the focus ring.
Pair every state color with a glyph and a word.
Take every visual value from a token. Run npm run brand:check before you push.
dont: Use amber for links, headings, logos, icons or the primary button.
Add a hue to the chrome without a role, a grant and a reason.
Clip content with a corner radius, or stack shadows to show hierarchy.
Copy a hex value into a component, or edit a generated file.

wordmark.note: BEATHAM in capitals, Instrument Sans Bold, black on light and white on dark. A placeholder until the wordmark is drawn.

icon.note: An amber rounded square (brand.50). A placeholder until the icon is drawn.

logo.note: The Beatham logo lockup (icon plus wordmark). Not yet drawn.

rules.note: Clear space and minimum size use the core mark.* tokens until a mark exists. On-color use and don'ts are written with the mark.

visualSystem: In the visual system the tenets read as precise (name the thing, the number and the fix), restrained (neutral carries the work) and made by hand (warm grays, a hero amber, filament colors from the bench).
origin: Beatham is a maker's workshop. Each product starts from a real person or story: candlelit family game nights became Pip, personal dental care became Confident. The tools are made to be used, so the work stays on the bench in plain view.
order: When the archetypes pull apart, Servant wins: helpfulness and clarity beat cleverness and play.

joy.default: Craft by default, play by invitation.
joy.body: Most Beatham products delight by being well considered and satisfying to use: HandCAD, BitBox, ManoMultiplier. Some earn a playful voice, like HandStack. Pip has the most room. Joy lives in the object, in the copy and in small moments, and only when it earns its place.

refusals: No engagement tricks: no streaks, nags or dark patterns.
Nothing self-important or self-abasing: don't talk the work up or down.
